summary: Genesis calls the waters that rose and lifted Noah’s ark the flood. Psalm 29 depicts Yahweh enthroned over the flood.

senses.definition: An overwhelming inundation of water, especially the flood in Noah’s day.

evidence.note: God announces that he will bring the flood upon the earth.
The clause identifies the flood as water upon the earth.
During the flood the waters increase and lift the ark above the earth.
Yahweh sits enthroned over the flood.
Noah and his family enter the ark because of מֵי הַמַּבּוּל, the waters of the flood.
Yahweh sits enthroned over the flood.
God announces to Noah that he will bring a flood of water upon the earth.
After seven days מֵי הַמַּבּוּל, “the waters of the flood,” were upon the earth.
